mobbin:cc79d322-0fc9-4e2e-ac99-94fc9bee9.summary: In a 1-of-2 Create App modal, author an AI prompt, pick ≥2 meetings, and enable Preview Notes before advancing — configuration and dry-run before using the agent.
steal: Step 1: Split UI — left natural-language instructions, right 'select meetings to preview / refine from output'.
Step 1–4: Preview Notes stays disabled until ≥2 meetings selected (hard gate on dry-run).
Step 4: Explicit Preview Notes CTA before Next (1 of 2) — human checks output before finishing setup.
avoid: Flow never shows step 2 or a share/publish screen — weak evidence for learner-facing approve-before-share; only agent-setup preview.
mobbin:cc79d322-0fc9-4e2e-ac99-94fc9bee9.fit: Pattern for faculty configuring what AI should extract from sim recordings and previewing on past sessions before it runs on live debriefs; extends Baseline AI summary/clips with a prompt+preview gate.

mobbin:e91b3485-47e0-458f-a4d9-a934d59e6.summary: Open a meeting: read General Summary and Notes with embedded timestamps, search the speaker-labelled Transcript / AskFred, and control playback (speed, ±10s, download, Share).
steps: Summary + Notes with timed link + transcript
Summary bullets + Notes heading + AskFred tab
steal: Step 1: AI Notes embed blue timestamp links (e.g. 06:33) that deep-link claims to the recording.
Step 1–2: Transcript peer tab AskFred keeps Q&A about the recording next to searchable speaker turns.
Step 1: Bottom bar exposes 1x speed, ±10s, Download, and thumbs feedback on AI in one strip.
avoid: Share is available while AI General Summary is already published — no edit/approve step before sharing (counter to Baseline human review).
mobbin:e91b3485-47e0-458f-a4d9-a934d59e6.fit: Closest Fireflies twin of SRV summary+transcript+playback; use for evidence-linked AI debrief text, but add faculty approve before learner Share/SSO links.

mobbin:0384c559-2a2e-4a37-9cb8-7be772d37.summary: From the Soundbite rail, open Create Soundbite, drag-select a range with live transcript highlight, then title the clip, set playlist/access, and Done.
steps: Soundbite rail: Create vs AI Soundbite
Create modal: Drag and Select defaults
Soundbite created: title + who can access
steal: Step 1: Dual entry — Create Soundbite (manual) and AI Soundbite side by side.
Step 2–3: Drag-and-select + START/END fields; selected span paints purple on transcript for verification before Create.
Step 2: Tabs Magic Soundbite / Keyword Soundbite offer alternate clip generators without leaving the modal.
Step 4: Post-create modal requires title + Who can access (Participants only) + Copy/Open before Done — human finalize.
mobbin:0384c559-2a2e-4a37-9cb8-7be772d37.fit: Strong human-review-before-publish model for Baseline AI clips: auto-suggest optional, trim against transcript, then permissioned publish — attach to session record after faculty Done.
